paragraphs: Fostering for Bradford's children is run by Bradford Children and Families Trust under the name Foster for Bradford. The Trust was registered with Ofsted as a fostering agency in April 2023, and the independent agencies listed below also cover the district.

Ofsted inspected Foster for Bradford in September 2025 and rated it good overall and in every area, an improvement on the requires improvement judgement from March 2024. At the time of the inspection the service had 443 approved foster carers looking after 566 children and young people.

The service offers respite, short-term, long-term and permanent fostering, as well as kinship care, remand fostering and staying put arrangements for young people over 18. Carers have a supervising social worker and can join support groups and enrichment events, and the service uses the Mockingbird model, in which a group of fostering households is supported by an experienced hub carer. New carers are expected to complete the national training, support and development standards within a year of approval.

The council has previously said it particularly needs carers for older children and teenagers, and part-time carers for children with disabilities, and that applicants need at least one spare room. To start, contact the team at fostering@bradford.gov.uk or on 01274 435100, and compare what it offers with two or three of the agencies on this page.
